title: Annotated interictal epileptiform discharges in intracranial EEG (iEEG) sleep data (Falach et al., 2024)
description: Multichannel intracranial EEG (iEEG) recordings from 25 epilepsy patients during sleep, collected at Tel Aviv Sourasky Medical Center and UCLA. The dataset includes 852 interictal epileptiform discharges, mostly from the medial temporal lobe, annotated by expert neurologists. It is intended to support the development and benchmarking of automated IED detection methods. Data are organized in BIDS format with electrode localization where available.
methods_description: Intracranial depth electrode recordings were acquired with a Blackrock system during overnight sleep and shared as short excerpts (61-291 s) in EDF format at 1000 Hz. Expert neurologists annotated interictal epileptiform discharges, and sleep stages were scored according to AASM criteria. Electrode coordinates are given in MNI152Lin space for 18 participants.
